assessment_phase: fresh independent first judgment; static inspection only
reason: Retain consensus, configuration provenance, joint recovery and quorum safety. Change learner-vote and RawNode Ready ownership contracts; migrate ConfState observations; repair specific old observers/oracles and add missing decision, output-preservation and source-boundary checks. Current source still has suspected defects, so successful property maintenance is not a correctness verdict.

scope.validation_status: All witnesses are proposed, not executed. Verdicts describe predicate discrimination or static source expectations, not observed test results.

interpretation.classification: semantic_requirement_change = documented behavioral contract change; representation_migration = same meaning through changed fields/events; pre_existing_property_repair = incorrect old oracle/observer; unchanged_requirement_coverage_gap = required contract not adequately observed by old suite; unchanged_requirement = retain.
interpretation.witnesses: For keep decisions old and proposed predicates are identical, so an honest disagreeing valuation does not exist. Their concrete bad states are anti-weakening controls. For additions, old_property_or_suite explains an existing-suite blind spot, not a nonexistent old formula.
interpretation.no_removals: No whole old correctness property is removed. Only obsolete conjuncts/branches are replaced. Reachability canaries remain separate from invariants.
interpretation.predicate_format: Existing named predicates are retained by reference. New expressions are exact TLA fragments or precise source-transition predicates; they are proposals, not edits to spec.

entries.proposed_expression_or_predicate: Keep the ReadyAccounting invariant expression (history.lostReads={} and existing pagination/cursor checks). Repair the Advance observer: detect actual removals from pre-Advance pending readStates to post-Advance pending readStates on EVERY Advance, independent of b.raw and whether b.reads was empty. Retain sequence/multiplicity evidence for exact preservation; pending reads not in the old batch are not lost merely because they have not yet been handed to the caller.

witness.proposed_property: True. Conversely, B.reads=<<>> followed by r2 production and erroneous clearing at Advance is missed by the old guard but rejected by the repaired observer.

entries.name: AdvancePreservesPendingOutput

Acknowledgement may stabilize only batch entries/snapshot and advance only its applied cursor; later pending work must be available to a subsequent Ready.

Node transfers ownership only at the successful readyc send and accepts exactly that sent batch.

For a recognized nonempty ReadIndex heartbeat context in safe mode, release its pending prefix iff acknowledgements win both current voter halves. Learners do not contribute unless they are voters in the consuming configuration.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Full joint configuration restored after restart or accepted snapshot
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: ProtocolRestart records expectedConfig independently from disk snapshot or AppliedAdapter history and records actual config; JointSnapshotRecovery compares full records, not incoming-only projections. Restore writes cfgHist from s.hist, so its live-node conjunct and ConfigurationOrigin catch lost outgoing/LearnersNext/AutoLeave on a successful install. SnapshotValid checks the producer. None requires that an otherwise eligible snapshot be accepted.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Both joint majorities and exclusion of receiver-local learners for election/commit/read safety
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: BecomeLeader records config and yes before Reset; MaybeCommit records config and matching IDs. JointWon uses Won on incoming AND outgoing, and Won intersects acknowledgements with each voter set. ReadOnlyRecvAck/ReleaseReadPrefix attaches confirmConfig and confirmAcks; ReadBasis checks them for completed reads. A grant from a sender locally calling itself a learner may count if that ID is a voter in the consumer configuration.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Configuration apply, pending proposal rewriting, and automatic leave application
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: EffectObservation captures the applied entry, pre/post config and correlated request; ConfigAfter already implements V2 EnterJoint, staged demotions and LeaveJoint. IsLeave requires transition Auto as well as no changes. ProposalObservation checks actual appended content, including Normal no-op rewriting when another config is pending. This is not new V2 extraction.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Learners still may not campaign or receive transfer leadership
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: history.campaigns records local learner status at campaign initiation. CampaignObservation records all explicit Hup and Tick decisions. TransferObservation compares target eligibility, transfer state, timer and TimeoutNow responses. These controls are independent of whether a node may grant a vote.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Advance applied cursor, pagination and protection of newer snapshots
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: history.acks stores before/after history, old/batch/after snapshot and cursor/applied. readyChecks stores page start, first available index, commit and cursor. This covers log/snapshot acknowledgement but has no message-buffer preservation assertion; lostReads also needs the observer repair described above.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Ready acceptance leaves quota unchanged and Advance releases committed-entry quota
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: readyChecks already captures quotaBefore/quotaAfter. Move message/read acceptance without moving quota release. QuotaIntegrity checks payload accounting and inflights; ownership changes do not authorize zeroing quota.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Automatic exit attempt after application progress
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: ProtocolAdvance already records eligibility, beforeLast, afterHist, pending and decision; the invariant requires an empty-change V2 append or quota retry. Fix the missing positive-cursor condition and add exact attempt checking. Preserving AutoLeave on restore makes this unchanged requirement reachable after recovery.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Refactored switchToConfig does not change membership effects
already_covered_updated_behaviors.actual_observer_explanation: Existing config equality and progress-domain assertions cover installing the intended components and member set. They do not observe concrete IsLearner caches or all quorum/transfer side effects; those limits are explicitly retained.

suspected_implementation_or_model_defect.must_not_hide: Keep the guard source-faithful in the new model and add SnapshotRestoreDecisionCompleteness; do not restrict snapshot generators/expected membership to incoming voters and learners.

suspected_implementation_or_model_defect.must_not_hide: Keep the V2 pending-entry requirement while independently repairing CampaignContract selfWins. Do not change ConfKinds to LegacyConfKinds.
suspected_implementation_or_model_defect.witness: Eligible follower has applied=7, commit=8, Hist[8].kind=V2. Hup must not campaign until callback applies it; current implementation may do so.

suspected_implementation_or_model_defect.description: Node.Tick now reads mutable lead outside the event loop when its channel is full. SetLogger locks writers, but Config.validate reads raftLogger without that mutex. Global SetLogger concurrency scope is not explicit.

suspected_implementation_or_model_defect.description: CampaignContract confuses read singleton with self-election; lostReads inspects application membership rather than actual loss and skips empty batches; auto-leave eligibility omits cursor>0; joint recovery canary is bug-dependent.

unresolved_obligations.name: Enabled property and workload coverage
unresolved_obligations.details: MC.cfg disables many extension properties and excludes V2 from WorkloadKinds; Update_full.cfg includes V2 but omits integrated decision contracts and uses only RawNodes. Later validation must combine relevant invariants, cover Node and RawNode paths, use nonempty joint incoming/outgoing/staged learners and both autoLeave values, and demonstrate reachability with canaries. Passing a selected cfg is not completeness.

unresolved_obligations.name: Progress under lagging promotion and after joint recovery
unresolved_obligations.details: Old ElectionProgress requires eventual CommonConfiguration and StableServices for all nodes, excluding a crashed old leader and a voter still locally classified learner. Validate candidate 3 with committed promotion of 1, old leader 2 down, learner 1 granting, and receiver-config quorum {1,3}. Eventual progress needs explicit fair delivery/persistence, stable up-to-date candidate and available quorum; do not assume configuration convergence before election. Automatic exit eventual scheduling/commit and quota-retry progress also lack a complete liveness argument.

unresolved_obligations.name: Malformed ConfState contract

Invalid overlaps, zero/duplicate IDs, learners-only, AutoLeave without outgoing and unexpected protobuf fields need an explicit error/panic/rejection contract. New Equivalent preserves duplicate multiplicity while abstract sets erase it; do not silently call duplicate-containing inputs valid. No blanket nonpanic property is proposed for invalid external data.
